rows.qt: To me, brave companions! Feel my radiance flow through you!

"You have forsaken your duty to my akhara. Yes... we do not abide weakness. But we also do not abide madness in the fervour of battle! Your slain dekhara will have their justice. You must pay." Varashta condemned Ruzhan to the ritual of the barya, sentenced to serve as a Djinn.
Skip a beat, hold your breath. Too slow a poison, only death.

"The snare was set on our fallen. Beetles burst from their flesh, flooding the sands. Their exploding carapaces halted the advancing enemy... but it was not enough. And for that... I grieve." Kelari admitted his wrongdoing to Varashta.
The irrepressible spirit of the wilds burns within you, roaring to be let loose.
I give you everything, my pets. Do not disappoint me.
Bonds forged in battle surpass ties of blood.
Let the Darkness consume you. Beyond the veil of death, there burns a black fire.

"Wipe the tears from your face, dear Navira. I did not deceive you. I meant every word. I will forever cherish you, my beloved. Know that I did it all for you... for our future!" Kelari pleaded with the Tale-woman.
Great tacticians learn that consistency often trumps potential.
A wooden construct, mute and blind. But fear the wrath of shackled mind.

"Kelari, you deceiver! I fell for your words, but no longer. Your sentence is a fate too good for you! I would give anything to bring back those who fell to your lies. Instead... I mourn my choices." Navira lambasted Kelari a final time.
While the mind endures, so too will the body.
Balance is good in all things, but especially in the realm of magic.
Your grandchildren will awaken screaming in memory of what I utter today.
The world is a pattern, moving in natural waves. With enough force, those waves can be made to converge...
Hope is a mistake. Pain is the only truth.
Lay open your veins, and draw power from your own spilled life.
Embrace the pain, drink it in. Your enemies will know your agony tenfold.
Give up everything in pursuit of greatness - even life itself.
In battle, certainty is worth a little pain.
What need have I for defence when my enemies are reduced to ash and splinters?
Strength begets respect. There is no simpler law.

"I have seen countless battles. I know war! The taste of defeat... The taste of victory! But in this war... everything is at stake. So yes, those you speak of will know my blade. I will do whatever I must!" Ruzhan confided in his Tale-woman, Navira.
The body is a weapon waiting to be mastered.
